conclusions.question: Creator data extractable?
conclusions.evidence: 9 of 11 creator fields populated for 3/3 creators (data/sample_creators.json); API creator/detail 31 fields, 200 (reports/api_probe_2026-11-15.json)

conclusions.question: Audience demographics? (UI yes, API no)
conclusions.evidence: UI gender/age stored 3/3; API has no audience fields (reports/api_probe_2026-11-15.json); geography locked on trial

conclusions.question: Commercial metrics?
conclusions.evidence: API full precision for revenue, video/live revenue, sales volume, followers; UI matches to display precision only (docs/DATA_DICTIONARY.md parity table)

conclusions.question: Individual video URLs?
conclusions.evidence: 6 video_ids captured (data/sample_videos.json); TikTok URLs derived, not fetched; 1 Kalodata MP4 downloaded (docs/FACTS.md Method 5)

conclusions.question: Frames + audio analyzable?
conclusions.evidence: Frames: 12 extracted, Agy analysis valid (reports/agy/MEDIA_FINDINGS.md). Vietnamese ASR BLOCKED (docs/FACTS.md Media test); faster-whisper HF 429 (docs/FACTS.md line 70)

conclusions.question: Missing or unreliable data?
conclusions.evidence: Likes/comments/shares missing 6/6; category and geography missing 3/3; Agy static-pouch error (frames 4, 12); cover .png is JPEG (docs/MEDIA_FEASIBILITY.md; docs/RISKS.md)

conclusions.question: Permitted methods?
conclusions.evidence: Open API documented (docs/FACTS.md Method 2); UI capture operator-supervised; ToS not in evidence (UNVERIFIED) (docs/EXTRACTION_METHODS.md)

conclusions.question: Measured extraction and inference costs?
conclusions.evidence: API 7 calls ~0.7 credit (reports/api_probe_2026-11-15.json, docs/FACTS.md); video URL 0.5 credit/call documented, not called; Agy tokens NOT captured, estimate 3,096 image tokens UNVERIFIED

conclusions.question: Resume after interruption?
conclusions.evidence: Ad hoc os._exit test: done 4/pending 4/running 1, resume to done 9 (docs/FACTS.md; script not in repo); tests/test_db.py:56 is a unit test; failed tasks not retried (src/kalodata_intake/db.py)

conclusions.question: 3-day MVP feasible?
conclusions.evidence: Recommendation GO, scoped: API for commercial data, UI audience on shortlist only (trial cap 10 detail visits/day = 30 over 3 days, derived), video analysis on shortlist only. 3-day duration UNVERIFIED; API scale throughput UNMEASURED
